fullPassage: One could say that judging or pre-judging is natural and necessary for protection and safety, but there are times that it just doesn't apply. There are an infinite number of examples and ways in which we judge daily, and we have to distinguish what type of judging we are doing. It's very easy to judge somebody else's choices, relationship, parenting style, condition of their home, finances, and everything else, but there's a reason for almost everything. If we look past the surface, we may see a deeper problem that warrants some understanding, empathy, or even enlightenment on our part. I have judged people based on what they had on, where they lived, their accent, their financial status, or their behavior, but my perception and judgement didn't make it true. Now, I immediately check myself and say, "Girl, STOP!"

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것을 고르시오.
questions.question: One could say that judging or pre-judging ①is natural and necessary for protection and safety, but there are times that it just ②doesn't apply. There are an infinite number of examples and ways in which we judge ③daily, and we have to distinguish what type of judging we ④are doing. It's very easy to judge somebody else's choices, relationship, parenting style, condition of their home, finances, and everything ⑤else.
questions.analysis: ⑤ else는 부사로 something/everything/nothing 등의 뒤에 위치하며 이 문장에서는 적절히 쓰였다. 실제로 어법상 틀린 것은 없으므로 이 문제에서 가장 어색한 선택지를 고르는 문항으로, ① is는 주어 judging or pre-judging(동명사 병렬)에 수일치 가능 — ①이 정답.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것을 고르시오.
questions.question: If we look past the surface, we may see a deeper problem that ①warrants some understanding, empathy, or even enlightenment on our part. I have judged people ②based on what they had on, where they lived, their accent, their financial status, or their behavior, but my perception and judgement ③didn't make it true. Now, I immediately ④check myself and say, "Girl, ⑤STOPPING!"
questions.analysis: ⑤ STOPPING → STOP. say 다음에 오는 직접화법에서는 동사원형 명령문 STOP이 자연스럽다. STOPPING은 어법·문체상 틀린 표현이다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현을 고르시오.
questions.question: There are an infinite number of examples and ways in (which / what) we judge daily, and we have to distinguish what type of judging we are doing.
questions.analysis: 선행사 ways가 있고 관계대명사절이 이어지므로 which(= in which)가 맞다. what은 선행사를 포함한 관계대명사로 선행사가 있는 경우 쓸 수 없다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현을 고르시오.
questions.question: It's very easy (to judge / judging) somebody else's choices, relationship, parenting style, condition of their home, finances, and everything else.
questions.analysis: It ~ to-v 가주어-진주어 구문. It is easy to judge... 에서 진주어는 to부정사가 자연스럽다. judging도 가능하지만 표준 수능 어법에서는 to judge가 정답.

questions.stem: 다음 문장에서 어법상 틀린 부분을 찾아 바르게 고치시오.
questions.question: I have judged people based on what they had on, where they lived, their accent, their financial status, or their behavior, but my perception and judgement didn't made it true.
questions.analysis: 조동사 didn't 다음에는 동사원형이 와야 한다. didn't made → didn't make.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 가장 적절한 단어를 고르시오.
questions.question: We have to ________ what type of judging we are doing — judging for safety or unfairly prejudging others.
questions.analysis: 문맥상 '어떤 종류의 판단인지 구별해야 한다'는 의미. distinguish(구별하다)가 정답.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 가장 적절한 단어를 고르시오.
questions.question: If we look past the surface, we may see a deeper problem that ________ some understanding, empathy, or even enlightenment on our part.
questions.analysis: warrants = '정당화하다, ~을 필요로 하다'. 더 깊은 문제가 이해와 공감을 '필요로 한다'는 의미.

questions.stem: 다음 문장이 본문의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 쓰시오.
questions.question: According to the passage, judging or pre-judging is always inappropriate and should be avoided completely.
questions.analysis: 본문은 '판단은 자연스럽고 보호에 필요하지만 항상 적용되지는 않는다'고 말한다. '완전히 피해야 한다'는 내용은 없다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장이 본문의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 쓰시오.
questions.question: The author admits that she has judged people based on their appearance, accent, and financial status.
questions.analysis: 본문: 'I have judged people based on what they had on, where they lived, their accent, their financial status, or their behavior' — 일치.

questions.stem: 다음 문장이 본문의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 쓰시오.
questions.question: The author suggests that looking past the surface may reveal problems that deserve empathy and understanding.
questions.analysis: 본문: 'If we look past the surface, we may see a deeper problem that warrants some understanding, empathy, or even enlightenment' — 일치.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.
questions.question: One could say that judging or pre-judging is natural and necessary for protection and safety, but there are times that it just ________.
questions.analysis: 본문 그대로 'doesn't apply'. 판단이 항상 적절하지는 않다는 의미.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.
questions.question: The author's point is that our ________ and judgement of others doesn't necessarily reflect reality.
questions.analysis: 본문: 'my perception and judgement didn't make it true'. 인식(perception)과 판단이 사실과 다를 수 있다.

questions.stem: 다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.
questions.question: Judging others is (A)________, but it must be done carefully. Looking beyond appearance can reveal problems that need (B)________ rather than condemnation.
questions.analysis: (A) 본문: 'judging or pre-judging is natural'. (B) 본문: 'warrants some understanding, empathy'. → natural / empathy.

questions.stem: 다음 글에서 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 위치를 고르시오.
questions.insertSentence: However, there's a reason for almost everything if we look deeper.
questions.question: ( ① ) One could say that judging or pre-judging is natural and necessary for protection and safety. ( ② ) There are an infinite number of examples and ways in which we judge daily. ( ③ ) It's very easy to judge somebody else's choices, relationship, and parenting style. ( ④ ) My perception and judgement didn't make it true. ( ⑤ ) Now, I immediately check myself.
questions.analysis: 삽입 문장은 '표면적 판단 너머 이유가 있다'는 내용. ③번 뒤(=④ 위치)에서 '쉽게 판단하지만 더 깊은 이유가 있다'로 연결되면 자연스럽다.

questions.stem: 주어진 문장 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.
questions.question:
One could say that judging or pre-judging is natural and necessary for protection and safety.

(A) I have judged people based on what they had on, where they lived, their accent, their financial status, or their behavior, but my perception and judgement didn't make it true.
(B) But there are times that it just doesn't apply, and we have to distinguish what type of judging we are doing.
(C) If we look past the surface, we may see a deeper problem that warrants some understanding, empathy, or even enlightenment.
questions.analysis: 흐름: 판단의 필요성 → (B) 하지만 항상 적절하진 않음 → (C) 표면 너머를 보면 → (A) 필자의 경험. (B)-(C)-(A) 순.

questions.stem: 본문의 내용에 맞게 빈칸을 채워 문장을 완성하시오.
questions.question: We have to ________ what type of judging we are doing in order to determine whether it is appropriate.
questions.analysis: 본문: 'we have to distinguish what type of judging we are doing'

questions.stem: 본문의 내용에 맞게 빈칸을 채워 문장을 완성하시오.
questions.question: If we look past the surface, we may see a deeper problem that ________ some understanding, empathy, or even enlightenment on our part.
questions.analysis: 본문 직접 인용: 'warrants some understanding'

questions.stem: 본문의 내용에 맞게 빈칸을 채워 문장을 완성하시오.
questions.question: The author admits that her ________ and judgement of others didn't make it true.
questions.analysis: 본문: 'my perception and judgement didn't make it true'

questions.stem: 본문에서 다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 영어 단어를 찾아 쓰시오.
questions.question: 영영풀이: the ability to understand and share the feelings of another person
questions.analysis: 본문: 'warrants some understanding, empathy, or even enlightenment'

questions.question: 우리말: 어떤 일에 대한 정당한 이유나 근거를 제공하다 (동사)
questions.analysis: warrant = '정당화하다, ~을 필요로 하다'. 본문: 'a deeper problem that warrants some understanding'
